name: Lewd Lore: Isekai Fantasy
source:
A young man’s life takes an unexpected turn when he's hit by a truck and wakes up in a magical world with some very naughty powers. 

Join him as he explores this new land, meets captivating girls, and builds romantic relationships.

[From [url=https://lewdlore.itch.io/isekai-fantasy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻人被卡车撞倒后，他的生活发生了意想不到的转变，他在一个神奇的世界中醒来，发现了一些非常顽皮的力量。

和他一起探索这片新大陆，结识迷人的女孩，并建立浪漫的关系。

[来自[url=https://lewdlore.itch.io/isekai-fantasy]itch.io[/url]]
